author: Rituhathi
author_bio: Co-Founder, UP&RUN - The Hydration Co.
text:
Stubble burning is a much bigger problem for businesses in the health and fitness category.

I’m a co-founder of a D2C brand that sells electrolytes to active people who run, sweat and play sports.

Every year, when stubble burning starts, pollution travels across the North, especially Delhi NCR.

People who usually go for a run avoid going outside, and people who play outdoor sports cut down their sessions.

People who cycle, walk or train outdoors start skipping it altogether.

And that eventually impacts the businesses built around these habits.

Electrolyte sales go down. Running equipment gets affected. Sports and outdoor fitness products see lower demand.

It’s not because people stop caring about their health but the environment makes it harder for them to maintain the lifestyle they were already following.

One research study on people exercising outdoors in Delhi NCR found that exposure to particulate pollution during exercise was associated with respiratory problems and changes in lung function.

Stubble burning can directly affect consumer behaviour and, eventually, sales. Sad but true 🙁

Around 2-5 units out of 100.

Stubble burning is episodic (mainly Oct-Nov, ~45-60 days). Recent DSS/CPCB data show season averages of 3.5-13% of PM2.5 (peaks higher on some days).
